VANCOUVER, BC – TheNewswire – November 25, 2026) GOLD’N FUTURES MINERAL CORP.
(FSE: G6M)

(the “Company” or “Gold’n Futures”) announces a non-brokered private placement of up to 12,000,000 units of the Company (the “Units”) at a price of $0.15 per Unit, for gross proceeds of up to $1,800,000 (the “Offering”).

Each Unit will consist of one (1) common share of the Company (a “Share”) and one (1) common share purchase warrant (a “Warrant”). Each Warrant will entitle the holder thereof to purchase one (1) additional common share of the Company at an exercise price of $0.20 for a period of twenty-four (24) months from the date of issuance.
The Company intends to use the net proceeds of the Offering for  general working capital purposes.

The Offering may close in one or more tranches. There is no minimum amount that must be raised under the Offering, and the Company may increase or decrease the size of the Offering at its discretion, subject to the policies of the Canadian Securities Exchange (the “CSE”).

In connection with the Offering, the Company may pay finders’ fees to eligible finders of up to 7% of the gross proceeds from Units sold to subscribers introduced by them, in cash, and issue non-transferable finder warrants equal to up to 7% of the number of Units sold to those subscribers. Each finder warrant will entitle the holder thereof to purchase one (1) common share of the Company at $0.20 for twenty-four (24) months from the date of issuance.
No insiders of the Company are expected to participate in the Offering.

The Units will be offered by way of private placement in reliance on available exemptions from the prospectus requirements under applicable Canadian securities laws. All securities issued under the Offering will be subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance, in accordance with applicable securities laws. Completion of the Offering is subject to the policies of the CSE. As proposed, the issuance of securities pursuant to the Offering would exceed 100% of the Company’s current issued and outstanding common shares on a fully diluted basis and is therefore subject to shareholder approval in accordance with the policies of the CSE. The Company intends to obtain such approval by way of written consent of shareholders holding more than 50% of the outstanding voting securities.

This news release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities in the United States. The securities have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or any state securities laws, and may not be offered or sold within the United States or to U.S. persons unless registered or exempt from registration.
About Gold’n Futures Mineral Corp.

Gold'n Futures Mineral Corp. is a Canadian mineral exploration and development company focused on the identification, acquisition and advancement of resource projects across a diversified range of commodities.
